category_name: This image depicts two colorful vehicles parked on a light-colored, dusty road. The scene is set under a vast, overcast sky. The road curves through the center of the scene, bordered by rough, sandy dirt and gray gravel. A large pink food truck is parked, and a group of people are gathered nearby next to a red octagonal stop sign. Parked just past the pink truck is a compact yellow utility truck. The combination of the bright vehicles and the expansive natural setting creates a striking contrast.
